text: Splash-m1 reports requests, prefill/decode rates, context and its memory plan, but not per-token router selections, PLE reads or draft acceptance; the Visualizer labels those regions instead of drawing them. The native rollback runtime reports them.

Speculative decoding uses the DFlash2 draft trained for the base Qwen3.8-Flash-Next; it is verified by each model, so outputs are unaffected, but acceptance (and so the speed-up) is that of a base-model draft for the fine-tuned Swift and Cyber.

Data-free 2-bit expert encoding flattens Cyber's opening distribution: 4 of 80 sampled openings of one agent request stopped after a few junk tokens (Scope and Swift 0 of 80); 2 of 21 historical agent sessions needed a retry. A calibrated re-encode is deferred.
The source is a W4A4 export; no Apple runtime reproduces its 4-bit activations, so the build is weight-faithful with full-precision activations.
Cyber has no refusal behaviour; in Full Auto, text in a page, file or screenshot can steer its tools without an approval step.

Cyber runs closest to the Metal limit: its 128K plan is 50.81 GiB against a 51.84 GiB recommended working set (1.03 GiB headroom), which is why it prefills in 1024-token chunks. A 1536-token chunk (plan 51.37 GiB) was started but not validated at depth and is not used.
Tokenizer conformance 257 of 339 on the unpatched runtime: no NFC normalization and 24 rarely-typed special tokens tokenized as text.
Video input is not exposed; the agent stack has no video path.
Zed's ACP thinking option cannot select reasoning effort, so each profile is its own editor entry.
dwarfstar-acp and Workstation chats never load a model; start it from the Workstation (or dwarfstar switch) first.
The KimiCU Calculator check was not re-run for Cyber XHIGH and Swift MEDIUM (screen locked at the time); it passed on Cyber LOW.

The reported Cyber MEDIUM -> Stop -> LOW failure was not reproduced exactly from the user's run (the service log of that run was not kept). The real-runtime gate found and fixed three lifecycle races that produce that class of failure while the window is open (ledger removal racing a status poll, stale cached state after a stop, telemetry session not finalized); the reported sequence and the full matrix now pass through the installed app's service and through the UI.
